Member Name: HOLEX’s Budget 2025 submission – A New Path for Growth: The People’s Skills Solution– sets out a clear vision for growth built around people, their potential, and lifelong learning.
In its submission, HOLEX calls for:
💷Fair and increased funding: a £5 billion boost to the adult skills budget over this Parliament, targeted through local networks that understand community and employer needs;
🎓 Equity of educational experience: consistent, high-quality provision for all adults, including those with SEND and those furthest from work;
📈Recognition of adult education: as a key driver of economic growth, wellbeing, and social cohesion; and
🤝Stronger cross-government coordination: bringing together DfE, DWP, MHCLG, MCAs, and local authorities to make lifelong learning more responsive and accountable.

People choose South London for its outstanding quality of life – great schools, abundant green spaces, rich arts and culture, thriving leisure scenes, and a strong sense of place. Add
excellent housing, heritage, easy access to Central London and the close proximity of the UK’s two main airports, it’s easy to see why our boroughs and sub region continue to grow.
That’s why we’re committed to working in partnership to deliver on three core investment and growth ambitions:
Investing in Place – to become a leading ‘go-to and stay’ place for inclusive, sustainable innovation
Investing in People – to deliver greater access for all our residents to do good work – higher quality, higher paid, & higher value jobs
Investing in Infrastructure – to better connect people with opportunity to support polycentric growth
